_doc: Effect / particle / sky / water textures (tools/assetgen/textures/gen/fx.py, sky.py). shader = std_surface placeholder bound through 'maps' (the real particle / water / sky shaders are the integrator's); 'fx' records the intended use. Flipbooks and atlases are row-major (left->right, top->bottom) square cells = Godot particles_anim_h_frames / v_frames. RGBA is straight alpha with colour bled under transparent texels; for additive blending use rgb * a.

fx.use: campfire / burning building / exhaust smoke puffs; frame 0 = birth, puff billows, thins into wisps and dies. Lit from the upper left; billboard with slight random rotation
campfire / torch / burning debris flames; seamless loop, base at the bottom of each cell
rising embers over fires (pick a random cell): round, streaked, glowing flake, tiny cluster
metal impacts, sparking wires; align +X with velocity and stretch
cells 0-1 front view stars, cells 2-3 side view cones pointing +X; pick randomly per shot, show 1-2 frames
rain drop streak sprites (4 columns, each 128 x 512); velocity aligned, soft ends
rain / drop splash on puddles and water seen from the side (crown, droplets, ripple), ~0.25 s lifetime
hit spurt spraying toward +X of the cell: jet, droplets, mist; orient along the hit normal
floating dust in sunbeams / abandoned interiors
pale floating Bloom spores around infected growth / Hollowed; slow drift
digging / bullet impacts on ground / footstep kicks; soil, sod, mud, stone chips (pick random cell)
axe chops on trees / logs / doors, wood bullet impacts (pick random cell)

lakes / rivers: blend normal_a (wind chop, scroll along +U with wind/flow) with normal_b (fine ripples, scroll another direction); water_foam is linear data: R = graded density (foam = R > 1 - amount), G = bubble lace, B = large-scale breakup

sky_cloud_noise: tileable linear RGBA Perlin-Worley octaves (R base, G mid, B fine, A erosion); sky_stars: 4096 x 2048 equirect (u = longitude, v = 0 at zenith), additive, black background, imported lossless without mip-maps; moon_disc: full-moon albedo, alpha = disc, north up
